data.exact_reserve_text: The Syndicate has loss reserves for various events and for IBNR. Losses continue to develop, both positively and negatively on these open balances. Whilst the Syndicate has a reasonable degree of confidence as to the ultimate adequacy of its reserves for all events, volatility exists around the final settlement value. Overall on an aggregate basis, reserve releases of GBP 1.4m net of reinsurance were made to prior year reserves during 2016. In 2015 there was a reserve strengthening of GBP 4.4m.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross opening claims reserves at 1 Jan 2016 were GBP 153.765m. Using the gross claims development table, prior-year development for years up to 2014 shows a net gross strengthening of approximately GBP 20.06m (c.13.1% of opening gross claims). On a net of reinsurance basis the report notes a small release of GBP 1.4m. The movement reflects mixed development across lines: favourable development in Property produced releases offset by adverse development in Professional Liability and Marine.
raw_causal_phrases: Losses continue to develop, both positively and negatively on these open balances.
Overall on an aggregate basis, reserve releases of GBP 1.4m net of reinsurance were made to prior year reserves during 2016.
In 2015 there was a reserve strengthening of GBP 4.4m.
Overall the reserve release in 2016 was primarily generated by the Property account offset by a strengthening of the Professional Liability and Marine account reserves.
data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year development was not provided as a single gross line in the movement note; figure above (20.057m) was calculated from the published gross claims development triangle (page 34) per the extraction rules. The report explicitly states a net (after reinsurance) release of GBP 1.4m, but no gross net-of-reinsurance split was published for the prior year movement. LOB-level movements are described qualitatively only (Property release; Professional Liability and Marine strengthenings) without quantified gross amounts.
